supportingSources.label: Hot Shots machine and playfield overview

strategy.overview: Complete the five white T-E-D-D-Y targets to light Lock and activate its ball hole, then shoot the lit Lock hole to begin two-ball Multiball. For the repeatable score route, complete B-E-A-R to raise the center Save target; knock it down to light the right ramp briefly for Collect Jackpot.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete the five white T-E-D-D-Y targets, then shoot the newly lit Lock hole for two-ball Multiball. Complete B-E-A-R to reset the center Save target; hit Save, then shoot the right ramp before Collect Jackpot times out.
strategy.summary: Complete T-E-D-D-Y and shoot the lit Lock hole for two-ball Multiball. Complete B-E-A-R to raise Save, knock Save down, then make the right ramp during its timed Collect Jackpot window.

quickInfo.name: Light Lock
quickInfo.summary: Complete the five white T-E-D-D-Y targets.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the newly active Lock hole.

quickInfo.name: Raise Save
quickInfo.summary: Complete the four B-E-A-R gallery targets.

quickInfo.name: Collect Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Knock down Save, then shoot the right ramp before the timer expires.

steps.text: Complete the five white T-E-D-D-Y targets to light Lock and activate the lock hole.
Shoot the lit Lock hole to hold the ball and serve the second ball for two-ball Multiball.
Complete B-E-A-R to raise the center Save target.
Knock down Save, then shoot the right ramp while Collect Jackpot is lit.

alternatives.title: Play the Shooting Gallery
alternatives.when: Use this while T-E-D-D-Y letters are awkward or the target banks are already close to complete.

steps.text: Knock down all sixteen colored drop targets to collect the lit Shooting Gallery value.
Return to the remaining white T-E-D-D-Y targets after the banks reset.
Complete T-E-D-D-Y and B-E-A-R together to collect the currently lit sequence value.
On default three-ball rules, the second same-ball sequence can light Extra Ball; tournament settings may convert it to points.

machineSetup: Confirm special and extra-ball conversions, sequence counts, and whether lock progress carries between balls or players.
Test every T-E-D-D-Y and B-E-A-R target, all colored drops, lock hole, center Save target, accelerator, and right Jackpot ramp.

cautions.issue: Collect Jackpot is timed after the Save target falls.
cautions.response: Do not hit Save without a plan for the right ramp; B-E-A-R must be completed again to raise it after the opportunity ends.
